set.body:
Outcome: a researcher can request matched conditions, inspect every residual imbalance, and recover exactly which contours were selected.

Scope: a concise R API returning the two condition sets, selected/unassigned IDs, original drawing links, feature specification, target/nuisance residuals, per-drawing and aggregate diagnostics, solver status/bounds, seed/settings, and elapsed resources. Provide set-level examples and an optional per-drawing mode with honest infeasibility. Validate all outputs after reconstruction. Recompute junctions and medial-axis properties if the user asks for those as diagnostics; never carry original relational scores onto changed drawings or present them as optimized constraints.

Acceptance:
- Repeated runs with the same inputs, specification, deterministic settings, and solver contract reproduce selections or document permitted equivalent-optimum behavior.
- Export/reload retains contour identity, provenance, specification, and diagnostics. Existing geometry-changing invalidation rules remain effective.
- Examples cover a feasible matched set, a per-drawing infeasible request, and a time-limited run with clear status.
- Reports show achieved target separation, each nuisance residual, and per-drawing imbalance; no apparent success obtained by silently relaxing constraints.
- Document the effects of comparing raw versus normalized histograms and of aggregating across drawings. Keep v1 scoped to whole-contour selection.
set.title: Expose paired stimulus subsets with reproducible diagnostics and provenance
